desc: 轻触即启，纤薄圆盘钻沙发底，扫吸拖一体，路径有序不乱跑
leaf: 圆盘触控纤薄扫吸拖扫地机器人
name: 圆盘触控扫吸拖一体扫地机器人款

shots.intent: 列表页一眼认出圆盘纤薄机身与顶部触控键，干净合规无文案
首屏一秒讲清轻触启动的差异化记忆点并立住光脚净家气质
shots.textZone: centred upper third: Latin eyebrow, headline and accent rule; one squircle chip at lower left

shots.intent: 放大低矮家具底面积灰与人工反复弯腰扫不到的挫败感
shots.textZone: top headline band plus a small tag on each panel

shots.intent: 把源页散在多屏的能力清单压成一格总览，一次看完建立配置感
shots.textZone: headline band top, six chip labels, floor strip label

shots.intent: 用底盘解剖证明万向轮、双边刷、密压集尘口与锁水拖布真实存在
shots.textZone: left column of five callout labels

shots.intent: 用同一块剖面把电机风道、电能芯与控制芯三屏合并解释，只讲结构不讲参数
shots.textZone: top headline plus three chip labels

shots.intent: 用同一户型两栏对比讲清有序行走与乱跑漏扫的差别
shots.textZone: two panel captions and a centre divider rule

shots.intent: 让买家代入真实居家地面，用反射与接触阴影坐实机器真的在地上走
用倾倒与冲洗三步讲清日常维护不脏手，替代源页容量话术
shots.textZone: top headline plus a three-step rail down the left

shots.intent: 平铺箱内所有配件，用实物数量打消配置疑虑
shots.textZone: top headline band plus one label chip under each item

shots.intent: 收口复述三个核心利益并给出下单理由，不留任何具体承诺
shots.textZone: upper headline block, three chip row, bottom action bar

style.backgroundSystem: flat mist #E7EDF2 plates alternating with cloud #F7F9FA infographic plates, plus real floor planes: pale honed stone #F7F9FA for studio screens and a pale timber plank floor #E9DCC9 for in-home screens, hairline #CFDCE5 rules and a #D7E2E9 horizon band; no deep dark plate anywhere in the set
style.iconSystem: duotone filled squircle chips: #F7F9FA tiles carrying #1E3241 pictograms with one #16B0A6 element each, plus schematic floor-plan line diagrams in #7C93A4 with dashed travel routes; step markers are small #16B0A6 squares with #FFFFFF numerals; never outline-only hairline icon sets and never circular numbered badges
style.lightingSystem: large soft north-daylight key from the upper left around 5600K with a low #16B0A6 bounce card at camera right, gentle falloff, no hard rim, no dramatic speculars; every floor is rendered with a true soft mirror reflection of the unit and a believable contact shadow that hugs the whole base circle so the robot never floats
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bright daylight clean-floor care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mist plate #E7EDF2, cloud infographic plate #F7F9FA, deep ink #1E3241 for every headline and label, hairline #CFDCE5 rules and one accent #16B0A6; neutral daylight temperature; one humanist rounded sans-serif family with wide letter-spaced Latin micro-caps eyebrows, no mixed fonts; backgrounds alternate flat mist and cloud plates with real pale honed-stone and pale timber plank floor planes, and no deep dark plate anywhere in the set; large soft north-daylight key from the upper left around 5600K with a low #16B0A6 bounce, gentle falloff and no hard rim; every floor shows a true soft mirror reflection of the unit plus a believable contact shadow hugging the whole base circle so the robot never floats; airy asymmetric plate layout with 24-radius squircle chips and small square step markers; duotone filled squircle icon set in #1E3241 with one #16B0A6 element, plus schematic floor-plan line diagrams in #7C93A4 with dashed routes, never circular numbered badges; the product is always the same low round disc robot from a stable repeatable angle set, its flush top deck and single raised circular touch key centred and readable, one real scale anchor in every floor screen, no lidar turret and no dock added; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no dark studio plate, no metallic accents, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no dark studio plate and no metallic accents
no invented spec numbers of any kind
no suction, battery, run-time, charging, noise, navigation, dustbin-volume, mop-pressure, app, warranty or certification claims
no child, pet, cable crossing the travel path or spilled water container
no floating unit and no missing floor reflection or contact shadow
no added lidar turret, tower, camera hump or emptying and washing dock
no hand touching brushes or the intake mouth
no QR code, membership corner badge or store logo
style.presentationRules: the robot is always the same low round disc body shown from a stable repeatable angle set (slight 3/4, floor-level low, extreme low upturned, 90-degree overhead, high 45-degree); one raised circular touch key stays centred and readable whenever the top deck faces camera, its illuminated arc keeps the exact hue of the reference image; scale is anchored by one real object (a slipper, a cabinet toe-kick or a sofa leg) in every floor screen; the top deck stays flush with no tower, turret or dock added
style.surfaceSystem: polished pale stone with a soft mirror reflection under studio screens, matte pale timber plank with visible grain under scene screens, matte paper #F7F9FA plates for infographics, and one transparent acrylic riser for the underside anatomy screen
style.typography: one humanist rounded sans-serif family, wide letter-spaced Latin micro-caps eyebrow above every headline, #1E3241 headlines and sub-lines, #16B0A6 only on rules and chips, three-layer copy per screen and never dense body text
